title: Phase 3 Study of Gedatolisib as First-Line Treatment for Patients With HR-Positive, HER2-Negative Advanced Breast Cancer (VIKTORIA-2)

rules.rule_text: Age at least 18 years
rules.source_text: Minimum age: 18 Years

rules.rule_text: Histologically or cytologically confirmed metastatic or locally advanced HR+/HER2- breast cancer
rules.source_text: Histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of metastatic or locally advanced HR+/HER2- breast cancer

rules.rule_text: Female patient
rules.source_text: Adult females, pre- and/or post-menopausal, and adult males.

rules.rule_text: Male patient
rules.source_text: Adult females, pre- and/or post-menopausal, and adult males.

rules.rule_text: Pre-menopausal or peri-menopausal women must be amenable to treatment with LHRH agonist
rules.source_text: Pre-menopausal (and peri-menopausal) women can be enrolled if amenable to treatment with an LHRH agonist.

rules.rule_text: Must have commenced LHRH agonist prior to or on Cycle 1, Day 1
rules.source_text: Patients are to have commenced concomitant treatment with LHRH agonist prior to or on Cycle 1, Day 1 and must be willing to continue for the duration of the study.

rules.rule_text: Must be willing to continue LHRH agonist for the duration of the study
rules.source_text: Patients are to have commenced concomitant treatment with LHRH agonist prior to or on Cycle 1, Day 1 and must be willing to continue for the duration of the study.

rules.rule_text: Negative pregnancy test for females of childbearing potential
rules.source_text: Negative pregnancy test for females of childbearing potential.

rules.rule_text: Females not surgically sterile must use medically effective contraceptive method from screening until 2 years after last dose of study treatment
rules.source_text: Female subjects who are not surgically sterile must use a medically effective contraceptive method from screening until 2 years after the last dose of study treatment.

rules.rule_text: Disease progression during or within 12 months of completing (neo)adjuvant endocrine therapy
rules.source_text: Progression of disease during or within 12 months of completing (neo)adjuvant endocrine therapy (ET) or progression of disease after 12 months of completing (neo)adjuvant ET.

rules.rule_text: Disease progression after 12 months of completing (neo)adjuvant endocrine therapy
rules.source_text: Progression of disease during or within 12 months of completing (neo)adjuvant endocrine therapy (ET) or progression of disease after 12 months of completing (neo)adjuvant ET.

rules.rule_text: Adequate archival, fresh tumor tissue, or liquid biopsy for PIK3CA mutational status analysis
rules.source_text: Adequate archival, fresh tumor tissue, or liquid biopsy for the analysis of PIK3CA mutational status.

rules.rule_text: (neo)adjuvant fulvestrant only if treatment duration < 6 months
rules.source_text: (neo)adjuvant fulvestrant only if the treatment duration < 6 months
rules.notes: If fulvestrant was used in (neo)adjuvant setting, duration must have been less than 6 months

rules.rule_text: (neo)adjuvant chemotherapy permitted
rules.source_text: (neo)adjuvant chemotherapy

rules.rule_text: (neo)adjuvant CDK4/6 inhibitor permitted unless PD on or within 6 months of discontinuation (Study 1) or unless PD >6 months after discontinuation (Study 1) or unless PD >12 months after discontinuation (Study 2)
rules.source_text: (neo)adjuvant CDK4/6 inhibitor, unless PD was on or within 6 months of discontinuation of CDK4/6i. i. Study 1: if disease progression was on or within event occurred >6 months of discontinuation after completion of CDK4/6 inhibitor portion of treatment. ii. Study 2: if disease progression event occurred >12 months after completion of CDK4/6 inhibitor portion of treatment.
rules.notes: Complex rule with study-dependent thresholds. Study 1 allows progression >6 months after discontinuation. Study 2 allows progression >12 months after discontinuation. Not eligible if PD was on or within 6 months of discontinuation.

rules.rule_text: Radiologically measurable disease per RECIST v1.1 by local assessment
rules.source_text: Subject has radiologically measurable disease according to RECIST v1.1, per local assessment.

rules.rule_text: Not bone-only disease (unless lytic or mixed lytic/blastic lesions with at least one measurable soft tissue component)
rules.source_text: Patients with nonmeasurable bone-only disease are not eligible. Patients with bone-only disease that has lytic or mixed lytic/blastic lesions and at least one measurable soft tissue component per RECIST v1.1 may be eligible.

rules.rule_text: ECOG performance status 0-2
rules.source_text: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0-2.

rules.rule_text: Life expectancy of at least 6 months
rules.source_text: Life expectancy of at least >6 months.
rules.notes: Original states >6 months; converted to >26 weeks

rules.rule_text: Adequate bone marrow function
rules.source_text: Adequate bone marrow, hepatic, renal and coagulation function.

rules.rule_text: Adequate hepatic function
rules.source_text: Adequate bone marrow, hepatic, renal and coagulation function.

rules.rule_text: Adequate renal function
rules.source_text: Adequate bone marrow, hepatic, renal and coagulation function.

rules.rule_text: Adequate coagulation function
rules.source_text: Adequate bone marrow, hepatic, renal and coagulation function.

rules.rule_text: Concurrent malignancies other than adequately treated non-melanoma skin cancer
rules.source_text: Concurrent malignancies other than adequately treated non-melanoma skin cancer.

rules.rule_text: Previous malignancies not in remission or with evidence of disease progression
rules.source_text: Previous malignancies in remission but curatively treated with no evidence of disease progression and judged by local Investigator to be at low risk of impacting health or survival while on study.
rules.notes: Previous malignancies are allowed if in remission, curatively treated, with no evidence of progression, AND judged at low risk by investigator

rules.rule_text: Prior treatment with PI3K inhibitor
rules.source_text: Prior treatment with a phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K) inhibitor, a protein kinase B (Akt) inhibitor, or a mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) inhibitor or any other selective estrogen receptor degrader (SERD), except fulvestrant, used in (neo)adjuvant setting.

rules.rule_text: Prior treatment with Akt inhibitor
rules.source_text: Prior treatment with a phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K) inhibitor, a protein kinase B (Akt) inhibitor, or a mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) inhibitor or any other selective estrogen receptor degrader (SERD), except fulvestrant, used in (neo)adjuvant setting.

rules.rule_text: Prior treatment with mTOR inhibitor
rules.source_text: Prior treatment with a phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K) inhibitor, a protein kinase B (Akt) inhibitor, or a mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) inhibitor or any other selective estrogen receptor degrader (SERD), except fulvestrant, used in (neo)adjuvant setting.

rules.rule_text: Prior treatment with SERD other than fulvestrant in (neo)adjuvant setting
rules.source_text: Prior treatment with a phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K) inhibitor, a protein kinase B (Akt) inhibitor, or a mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) inhibitor or any other selective estrogen receptor degrader (SERD), except fulvestrant, used in (neo)adjuvant setting.
rules.notes: Fulvestrant is excluded from this exclusion (i.e., fulvestrant is allowed)

rules.rule_text: Prior systemic anticancer therapy for advanced/metastatic breast cancer

rules.rule_text: Type 1 diabetes

rules.rule_text: Uncontrolled type 2 diabetes requiring daily insulin therapy
rules.source_text: Subjects with type 1 diabetes, or uncontrolled type 2 diabetes requiring daily insulin therapy.

rules.source_text: Known and untreated, or active, brain or leptomeningeal metastases
